description: The top-level keys of a scan_engine entry in a setup file, as imswitch.imcontrol.model.SetupInfo.ScanEngineInfo declares them. managerProperties is described per manager under managers/. Keys the dataclass does not declare are kept but not read.

managerName.description: The scan engine's manager: a registered ``scan_engine`` id or alias.

managerProperties.description: Properties to be read by the engine (its board's capabilities).

triggerInput.description: The line, driven by the engine the scan panel runs on, that this engine's trigger input is wired to. It then follows that engine step by step in a program that uses its devices (a pulse at every step).

title: scan_engine device entry (ScanEngineInfo)
